both keys are stored, so 0 rows are inserted, although (key, time) is new

div.div:
A move that lost, and the answer
row holds the target (admitted to running, row running): moved, the new events are written, lost null
row terminal (running to succeeded, row cancelled): nothing written, lost cancelled, the workflow completes
paused to cancelled, row resume-pending: moved again from resume-pending, written, lost null
any other (running to succeeded, row paused): rolled back, lost paused, the workflow sends again with backoff
